minutes.headline: Planning Board voted to link the two historic bylaws and continued both the rezoning and Highfield Village hearings.
minutes.summary: The board met with the Historical Commission on the Village Center District and Architectural Preservation District bylaws and voted to link them for Town Meeting. It continued the public hearing on rezoning 790-792 and 748 Mass Ave to April 27 and continued the Highfield Village cluster subdivision hearing to May 11. It also received an ANR plan, approved minutes, and discussed minor bylaw amendments and freestanding signs.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to link the two historic bylaws, so that if the Architectural Preservation District fails at Town Meeting, withdrawal of the Village Center District is requested.
The board continued the public hearing on rezoning 790-792 and 748 Mass Ave to limited business residential to April 27, after a first motion was withdrawn.
The Highfield Village cluster subdivision hearing was continued to May 11, with the board noting application fees are not meant to cover years of review.
The planning director is to get clarification on limited business uses and distribute it before April 27.
The board agreed not to pursue a freestanding sign change at Town Meeting and to revisit it later.

why_it_matters: Linking the two bylaws means a Town Meeting vote on one district can decide the fate of the other, and residents may be asked to vote on both.
The rezoning of 790-792 and 748 Mass Ave would change what may be built on those lots, and abutters and neighbors can still speak when the hearing resumes.

May 11 at 6:35: continued Highfield Village cluster subdivision hearing.
